digest.component_or_area: src/rebar codebase comment taxonomy and relocation
propositions: Six subsystems contain ~2,033 lines of recoverable comments (history, rationale, contracts) that should be relocated from inline src to tickets, ADRs, or schema per taxonomy.
The reconciler subsystem contains 28 sites with self-referential prose explaining the 800-line-per-file cap, which itself consumes the budget it documents.
Multiple files (event_append.py, _processors.py, signing.py) contain load-bearing comments documenting replay-compat and security invariants that cannot be relocated without breaking correctness.

Verified-stale comments exist at six sites documenting live invariants (DET_CHECKS range, Anthropic constraints, backend registry status, import order) that must be corrected in place rather than deleted.

A `do_not_move` protection list must be preserved in .joe-janitor/tools.md across all six shards to prevent future sweeps from re-flagging load-bearing anti-refactor warnings and measured external-API facts.
The six shards (9ce8, 4fc1, 4b94, ad16, da4c, ab77) must land in dependency order as separate stacked changes with measured per-shard line recovery and no behavior changes to test suite or linting.
